items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: a boy named Lee Wilson. He played very good. He was a very good piano player.

ctx.x: couple of sax. It didn't have no trombone. It had a couple of trumpets. About seven or eight of them. Then ...(?).... a boy named Lee Wilson. He played very good. He was a very good piano player. And he'd be sitting up there in the church playing the piano. He didn't have drums! You see, all that to contend with. Because see, the people out there in the church, they didn't pay no attention, they didn't know, but I've seen(?) it. He loved it. That's what killed him. Yeah. Sure did, in Hot Springs, Arkansas.
